title: Source files
responsibility: Lists source files with commit-pinned GitHub links and per-file modal actions on the Source tab.

inputs.name: DetailsPanel.entity
inputs.description: Entity supplying its identifier and owned source paths. Reads are scoped to this identifier; an empty list shows an explicit no-files message.

inputs.name: DetailsPanel.workspace
inputs.description: Workspace supplying the source-reading bridge, snapshot revision commit and project context. These are required when a source is selected. Failures during that request, including unavailable required context, are caught and shown as text.

inputs.name: DetailsPanel.title
inputs.description: Display name used by the source-modal action and dialog.

outputs.name: DetailsPanel
outputs.description: Actual file paths link to GitHub at the selected commit when available. Each row opens that file in the shared modal through the authorized bridge.
